[h2]On the occasion of today's Daily Deal - we bring you the release of our new expansion - Setup Guru Update🖥️! [/h2]

[h3]The new update will focus on outfitting new offices with computer equipment💾. Tasks will consist of buying computers, monitors, cables - connecting everything together, uploading the system and the necessary applications📁. Sound interesting? [*]Collision fix when held item is hidden
[*]Fix to inventory when it's full and we place the item
